title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Added a guest-matching fallback for the community search filter: when no lobby hosted through this mod is found, it now also tries vanilla (non-modded) lobbies posted to that community's own recruitment board, joining automatically when one matches your conditions. Also added a confirmation sound when matching successfully joins a lobby, and fixed several timing bugs around cancelling an in-progress match search.
